name: Agiled
description: Agiled.app is a comprehensive business and work management platform designed to help users manage their entire business operations in one place. It integrates several key functionalities, including Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Human Resource Management (HRM), financial management, project and task management, contracts, and professional proposals.
